verdict.rationale: Noise suppression is a fair axis for a voice-agent platform, so it applies. The evidence pack never mentions noise suppression, background-noise filtering, or audio filtering. The conversation-flow settings for silence, interruptions and turn-taking are an adjacent feature, not audio filtering, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls
